body.label: Effect
body.html: Each target gains +1 Defense until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Until your next turn, forced movement against you is reduced by 1 unit.
After this resolves, your next 2 units of movement this turn do not trigger Reactions.

rider.title: GUARD — STANCE
rider.html: Enter Iron Crane Stance. While in this Stance and adjacent to an ally, you and adjacent allies reduce forced movement against you by 1 unit. Entering another Stance replaces it; becoming Prone ends it.
